clue.text: Run and lift up sporting projectile

parts.note: to run a regular service back and forth is to shuttle
to cock is to raise or tilt upwards, as with an ear or a hat

explanation.surface: An instruction to dash and pick up a ball or other missile in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A shuttlecock is the feathered missile hit back and forth in badminton.

clue.text: Layer on diseased bean plant

parts.note: a hen lays eggs, so it is a layer

indicators.note: diseased means in a bad state, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: A hen sitting on a sick bean plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Henbane is a poisonous plant of the nightshade family.

clue.text: Jelly and custard ultimately polished off by youth in outdoor cafe

indicators.note: eaten up, so the food goes inside the youth

parts.note: a teen is a young person
agar is a jelly made from seaweed

indicators.note: only the final letter of custard is used

explanation.surface: A youngster eats jelly and the last of the custard at an outdoor cafe.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea garden is an open-air refreshment place serving tea and cakes.

clue.text: Flower everyone can see in a bundle

indicators.note: signals that one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a bundle of money is lots
U is the British film rating for universal, fit for everyone to watch

explanation.surface: A flower in a bunch on public display.
explanation.definitionFit: The lotus is a water lily, sacred in Asian religions.

clue.text: Reportedly topical fruit

indicators.note: signals that the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: topical news is current

explanation.surface: A fruit that is said to be in the news.
explanation.definitionFit: A currant is a small dried grape or a berry of the Ribes bush.

clue.text: Charlie learnt to dance for chief

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: letters made to dance are jumbled

explanation.surface: Charlie learnt to dance for the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: Chief and central both mean principal or main.

clue.text: Magic worker in children's competition

definitions.meaning: read whimsically, a bee (worker) that does spelling, casting spells

explanation.definitionFit: A spelling bee is a contest where pupils spell words aloud; whimsically, a worker insect casting spells.

clue.text: Beautiful remains in Scottish castle

parts.note: glam is short for glamorous, beautiful
to remain is to continue to be, as in is

explanation.surface: Lovely ruins found in a castle in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamis Castle in Angus is famous from Macbeth and the Queen Mother's childhood.

clue.text: Italian food: five parcels cold in the middle

indicators.note: to parcel is to wrap up, so the first piece wraps around the second

parts.note: penta- is the Greek prefix for five

indicators.note: only the central letters of the word cold are used

explanation.surface: A menu note about an Italian dish: five packages served chilled at the centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'five' points to the Greek prefix rather than a Roman numeral, which is the natural first guess.
explanation.definitionFit: Polenta is a cornmeal porridge, a staple dish of northern Italy.

clue.text: County functioning within Middle Eastern city

indicators.note: signals that one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: Tyre is an ancient port city in Lebanon
a machine that is functioning is on

explanation.surface: A county operating inside a Levantine city.
explanation.walkthrough: TYRONE is a county of Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Tyrone is one of the six counties of Northern Ireland.

clue.text: Ordinal with little time showed the way to embrace divinity, finally

indicators.note: joins the time piece to the rest

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time

indicators.note: the leading piece wraps around the other

parts.note: to show the way is to lead, go first

indicators.note: only the last letter of divinity is used

explanation.surface: A number with a moment, leading the way to embrace divinity in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Twenty-first is an ordinal number, giving position in a sequence.

clue.text: Prayer interrupted by depraved dance

indicators.note: the first piece is broken open by the second going into it

parts.note: a lama is a Buddhist monk, read here as one who prays
depraved means wicked, bad

explanation.surface: A prayer cut short by a wicked dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prayer' looks like an act of devotion; read it as 'one who prays', a LAMA.
explanation.definitionFit: The lambada is a fast, sensual Brazilian partner dance popular around 1990.

clue.text: Bird, fish-eating swine!

indicators.note: the first piece takes the second inside it, as if eating it

parts.note: a sow is a female pig
a parr is a young salmon

explanation.surface: An exclamation calling some bird a fish-eating pig.
explanation.definitionFit: The sparrow is a small, common brown songbird.

clue.text: Matter cleaner, wiped at the front

indicators.note: the opening letter is rubbed out

parts.note: a tissue is used to wipe things clean

explanation.surface: Something about a cleaning product being wiped at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue is a matter or topic under discussion.

clue.text: Caught in the end, marathon unfinished — athletic event

indicators.note: signals that one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: death is the end of life
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: the final letter is left off

parts.note: a marathon session is a long one

explanation.surface: A runner is overtaken at the finish, the marathon not completed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'marathon' is an adjective here, meaning lengthy, not the race; 'the end' means death.
explanation.definitionFit: The decathlon is a ten-discipline track and field contest.

clue.text: Island, besmirched, also featured

parts.note: Cos (Kos) is a Greek island
besmirched means smeared, tarred

explanation.surface: An island, its name smeared, also appeared.
explanation.definitionFit: Co-starred means appeared in a film alongside another star.

clue.text: Flip three articles into traps

indicators.note: signals that the articles go inside the other piece

parts.note: trap and gob are both slang for the mouth
an, an and a are indefinite articles

explanation.surface: Three items flipped into traps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'traps' is British slang for mouths, here plural to match the plural slang GOBS.
explanation.definitionFit: To flip, in slang, is to lose one's temper or composure, which is going bananas.

clue.text: Video's ending after sticker put on it — it's a wrap!

indicators.note: the video's final letter comes after the rest

parts.note: a burr is a prickly seed head that sticks to clothing

indicators.note: only the final letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: A film director calling time once the video ends.
explanation.definitionFit: A burrito is a tortilla wrapped round a filling, so literally a wrap.

clue.text: Close game — is one on late?

parts.note: close means near, nigh
a tie is a match, as in a cup tie

explanation.surface: A close match: is one being played late?
explanation.definitionFit: A nightie is a nightdress, a garment worn late in the day.

clue.text: Froggy doggy

definitions.meaning: with a frog in the throat

explanation.definitionFit: Husky means hoarse in voice, and is also an Arctic sled dog breed.

clue.text: Person held ticket to access Tube

indicators.note: the ticket goes into the tube

parts.note: a hose is a flexible tube
a tag is a label or ticket

explanation.surface: Someone stopped at the barrier with a ticket for the London Underground.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tube is the London Underground railway, a misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A hostage is someone held captive as security.

clue.text: On the radio, party sounded relieved

indicators.note: broadcast speech, so the word is heard

parts.note: a side is one party in a dispute

explanation.surface: A political party heard on air sounding relieved.
explanation.definitionFit: A sigh is a breath of relief, so one who sighed sounded relieved.

clue.text: Shaved king, going grey, seeing red!

indicators.note: shaving trims a thing at its edges, so the king's name loses its first and last letters

parts.note: Henry is the name of eight English kings
someone going grey is aged

explanation.surface: A king, clean-shaven and turning grey, is furious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shaved' cuts the outer letters of HENRY, leaving ENR.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing red is an idiom for being furious, which is enraged.

clue.text: Heartlessly delivered a letter from Thessaloniki

indicators.note: the central letter is taken out

parts.note: to deliver a blow or cards is to deal them, dealt

explanation.surface: A letter cruelly delivered from a Greek city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartlessly' removes the middle A of DEALT.
explanation.definitionFit: Delta is the fourth letter of the Greek alphabet, used in Thessaloniki.

clue.text: Weapon, being that one thrown around say in South Africa

parts.note: being that means since, which is as

indicators.note: the South Africa letters are thrown around the other piece

parts.note: eg (for example) is signalled by say
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A weapon that is thrown about, as might be done in South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in South Africa' looks like part of the definition, since the spear is southern African; it supplies letters instead.
explanation.definitionFit: An assegai is a slender iron-tipped spear used by southern African peoples.

clue.text: Arm lifted briefly, good earlier

indicators.note: the good piece comes before the other

parts.note: pi is short for pious, good

indicators.note: the final letter is cut short

parts.note: lifted means stole

explanation.surface: An arm raised quickly, good done beforehand.
explanation.definitionFit: An arm is a weapon, and a pistol is a handgun.

clue.text: Prophets erred, as fake

indicators.note: something fake is not genuine, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Seers who got it wrong, revealed as frauds.
explanation.definitionFit: Readers of palms or tea leaves foretell the future, as prophets do.

clue.text: Nothing treats excess fat

parts.note: love is zero in tennis
to handle something is to treat or deal with it

explanation.surface: Avoiding treats as a cure for flab.
explanation.definitionFit: Love handles is a jokey term for fatty bulges at the waist.
